raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
PwC Acceleration Center – Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Analyst | Data Quality Control (Assurance) | Ethics and Compliance Associate (Level 3) - Feb 2023 – Present | Kolkata, India
Led a global remediation initiative resolving operational status discrepancies across 120+ legal entities, improving revenue alignment, data accuracy and enterprise master data quality.
Managed the end-to-end Master Data Management (MDM) lifecycle for legal entities, ensuring compliance with SEC, AICPA, GICS and PwC standards.
Served as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Legal Entity Management (LEM), driving
data governance, SOP development, quality assurance and cross-functional collaboration.
Managed EMS and CDO requests, validating legal entity hierarchies with 97%
accuracy and 96% positive client feedback.
• Executed IT General Controls (ITGC) testing, including user access, change
management and logical access reviews ensuring SOX compliance, improving audit readiness and achieving a 98% quality and process efficiency rate.
Led Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) initiatives by evaluating internal controls, tracking remediation activities and collaborating with Audit, IT, Legal and Risk teams, resulting in a 60% improvement in revenue alignment and enhanced operational efficiency.
Led project go-live activities achieving 95% project efficiency through testing,
documentation and process standardization.
Automated compliance dashboards using Power BI and Alteryx reducing audit
preparation time by 40%.
Supported regulatory audits, entity lifecycle management, data lineage and
SEC/CFTC/NFRR regulatory reporting.
Leveraged Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Chat PwC) to improve
team productivity by 15%.
PwC Acceleration Center – Risk Management | Quality Control Auditor | Regulatory Governance Specialist Associate (Level 2) - Jun 2022 – Jan 2023 | Kolkata, India
Served as a Data Steward ensuring the accuracy, integrity and governance of audit
data in compliance with SEC, SOX, PCAOB and internal risk frameworks.
Performed internal audits and regulatory risk assessments for Fortune 500 clients, identifying control gaps, supporting remediation initiatives and improving audit turnaround time by 25% while maintaining 98% quality and compliance standards. • Supported fraud investigations through data-driven analysis and strengthened audit readiness through internal control reviews.
Standardized governance documentation and knowledge-sharing practices
improving operational efficiency by up to 80%.
Trained, mentored and coached a team of 15 new associates on Data Governance, Master Data Management (MDM) and data quality best practices, accelerating onboarding, strengthening process compliance and improving team productivity
Contributed to Enterprise Risk Management by conducting operational risk
assessments, executing control testing, enhancing risk controls and compliance monitoring and driving regulatory compliance, corporate governance, data stewardship and business process improvement initiatives
Axis Securities Ltd. | Senior Executive – Equity Advisory APRIL 2021 – JAN 2022 | Location: Kolkata, India • Delivered financial advisory and market insights to retail clients in equity, mutual funds, and SIP investments. • Promoted regulated financial products in accordance with SEBI and NISM standards. • Provided reporting and documentation support for compliance verification and KYC/AML checks.
KEY ACHIEVMENTS Promoted from Associate 1 to Associate 3 within three years in recognition of consistent high performance, strong ownership and successful delivery of business- critical initiatives.
Achieved a 95% success rate in project deliverables for US clients while maintaining a 98% quality score, consistently earning positive client feedback.
Earned annual performance bonuses, awards, and special commendations from senior US leadership in recognition of exceptional performance, consistent delivery of high- quality outcomes and significant contributions to client success.
Improved data accuracy and consistency by 25% through data profiling, segmentation, and process optimization while leading a business-critical project go-live that enhanced process documentation, SOP and standardization and compliance by 30%.
Increased workflow efficiency by 15% by leveraging AI tools, including ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot, to automate routine tasks, streamline workflows and improve operational productivity.
